Module it.polimi.ingsw
Package it.polimi.ingsw.Model.Cards

Class ObjectiveCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.Model.Cards.ObjectiveCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ObjectiveCard extends Object implements Serializable
Represents an objective card in the game, defining its attributes such as ID, objective type, secrecy, color, and points associated with achieving the objective.
